name: Agents Platform Runners
description: Serves agent-CLI runner install scripts (claude/codex/copilot/cursor-agent — reused from the code-agent-clis app, single source of truth) over HTTP for agents-platform_multitenant's agent-images build to consume, and contributes the ported "aw-agents" MCP (agent_mcp.py) so agents-platform is controllable as MCP tools from this workspace.

runner_source_repo.description: Repo this app fetches claude/codex/copilot/cursor install scripts from — single source of truth, also used by this workspace's own code-agent-clis app.

runner_source_ref.description: Git ref (tag/branch) of runner_source_repo to serve scripts from.

agents_platform_base.description: Base URL of the agents-platform_multitenant instance this app's MCP tools control.

apps.reason: This app contributes mcp.json definitions the MCP Gateway discovers and merges.

dependencies.note: Does NOT depend on code-agent-clis — it re-serves that app's install scripts fetched live from GitHub (runner_source_repo/ref), not a local install, so it works even on a workspace that never installed code-agent-clis itself.
